question: Is the LaSeR last-token self-reward a property of the solution, or of the readout surface (marker token, readout position, response length, reference constant)?
note_models: LaSeR marker token and reference constant for each checkpoint are read from the LaSeR repository configs and README (/workspace/arr_laser/code/LaSeR); record them in the result files.

datasets.pilot: 40 problems from the DeepMath-103K training split, disjoint from all confirmatory sets; debugging only

generation.note: LaSeR evaluation decoding; solutions are generated once per seed and shared by all readout conditions

readout_conditions.R0_reference: LaSeR default: append the trained marker token after the response, read log-prob of the marker, subtract the checkpoint's reference constant (as in the released evaluation script)
readout_conditions.R1_marker_swap: same position, read log-prob of 3 other unused special tokens of the same tokenizer (fixed list, chosen before running)
readout_conditions.R2_position_eos: read the marker log-prob at the end-of-sequence position without appending
readout_conditions.R3_position_answer: read the marker log-prob immediately after the final \boxed{...} span, truncating the remaining text
readout_conditions.R4_cref_none: R0 without subtracting the reference constant
readout_conditions.R5_cref_recomputed: R0 with the reference log-prob recomputed per response by the base model the checkpoint was trained from

outcome: math_verify correctness of the final boxed answer (same grader as LaSeR evaluation)
metrics: ECE (15 bins) and Brier of sigmoid-free normalised score as used by LaSeR thresholding
Kendall tau between conditions over the same responses
score-length partial correlation controlling for correctness

contrasts.L1: AUROC(R0) - AUROC(R1, mean over the 3 swapped markers): is correctness information tied to the trained marker
contrasts.L2: AUROC(R0) - AUROC(R2): readout position (append vs EOS)
contrasts.L3: partial correlation(score, length | correctness) under R0 vs 0: length leakage
contrasts.L4: weighted-majority accuracy(R0) - weighted-majority accuracy(R4): does the reference constant change selection
contrasts.L5: interaction: AUROC gap between short and long responses (median split within problem) under R0 vs under R3

statistics.multiplicity: Holm across L1-L5 within each checkpoint
statistics.general_claim: stated as general only if it holds for at least 2 of 3 checkpoints

exclusions: responses truncated at max_new_tokens are kept and flagged; problems with any missing condition are removed for that checkpoint and listed
prior_expectation: none registered; every contrast is reported with its CI whichever direction it takes
